integrity: All six graph types and all four seed orbits computed by exact fractions; full labeled-state comparisons on five types. Public 2020 journal result for balanced double stars, including the known 22-vertex switch, is explicitly excluded from the claimed novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem exhaustively classifies only proper double stars with at most nine vertices, using finite exact rational recurrence evaluation; no all-order theorem or priority certification is asserted.
title: First leaf-optimal proper double star for probabilistic zero forcing
